description: This Java class 'ImportDocument' models an import operation within the Fineract platform. It manages metadata related to bulk import documents including references to the actual document, timestamps, user who initiated the import, and success/failure counts.

classes.name: ImportDocument
classes.description: Entity class representing an import document, including its metadata and status within the bulk import framework.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ImportDocument instance with initial default success and failure counts, and current local time as end time.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the import document's end time, success count, and failure count, and marks it as completed.
